Use answer= only when the task asks a question, as the bare value. Lists: page_limit max 20, loop page_index until empty. Genre/release_date/play_count only from show_song. Ignore if it does not fit.

Use answer= only when the task asks a question, as the bare value. Lists: page_limit max 20, loop page_index until empty; collect all before changing. Ignore if not fitting.
phone: FINISH: if the task only asks you to DO something (send, delete, set alarm), call complete_task() with NO answer; any answer (count, id, 'done') fails grading. Use answer= only when the task asks a question, as the bare value. Login username = phone number. Lists: page_limit max 20, loop page_index; collect all before deleting. Ignore if not fitting.

Use answer= only when the task asks a question (how many/what/which), as the bare value. show_directory returns path strings; os/pathlib/open are blocked. Ignore if it does not fit.
simple_note: FINISH: if the task only asks you to DO something (create, export, update, delete), call supervisor.complete_task() with NO answer; any answer (a count, id, 'done') fails grading. Use answer= only when the task asks a question (how many/what/which), as the bare value. Lists are paged (page_limit max 20). Ignore if it does not fit.
supervisor.complete_task: Action-only tasks (do something, no question asked): call complete_task() with NO answer; any answer fails. Question tasks (how many/what/which): answer= the bare value only, not a sentence. Ignore if the task says otherwise.
spotify.show_album: Songs are under songs[i]['id'] (no song_ids key). Release date, genre, play_count are not here; use show_song. Library lists (show_album_library/show_playlist_library) do have song_ids.
spotify.show_song: Takes no access_token. genre is ONE string (not a list); also release_date, play_count, like_count, rating. Take the year from release_date[:4]. show_song_privates has no counts.
phone.search_contacts: Each contact has 'relationships' (a list) and 'email'. Filter a group with relationship= (see show_contact_relationships); query= is a fuzzy text search. Default page_limit is 5, max 20: loop page_index until empty.
venmo.search_users: Fuzzy name/email search; results can be unrelated people. Users have email, first_name, last_name (no id). To test whether someone has an account, compare email exactly. Default page_limit 5, max 20.
venmo.show_received_payment_requests: Items have payment_request_id, sender, receiver, approved_at, denied_at (no status/id keys); filter with status='pending'. Match people by sender/receiver email. Default page_limit 5, max 20: loop page_index.
phone.get_current_date_and_time: Returns {'date': 'Thursday, May 18, 2023', 'time': '12:00 PM'}; parse date with strptime('%A, %B %d, %Y'). Use this, not the system clock, for today/yesterday/this year.
spotify.show_artist: Takes artist_id only (no access_token). Field is follower_count (not followers). To know if you follow them, use show_artist_following (returns {'following': bool}) or show_following_artists. Ignore if it does not fit.
spotify.search_songs: No access_token. Params: query, artist_id, album_id, genre, min/max_release_date, min/max_duration, min/max_rating, min/max_like_count, min/max_play_count, page_index, page_limit, sort_by. Fuzzy: compare returned titles exactly. Print one item to see its keys. Max page_limit 20. Ignore if it does not fit.
spotify.search_artists: No access_token. Params: query, genre, min/max_follower_count, page_index, page_limit, sort_by. Fuzzy: compare the returned name exactly before acting. Artist detail (follower_count): show_artist. Ignore if it does not fit.
spotify.search_albums: No access_token and no artist filter: params query, genre, min/max_rating, min/max_release_date, min/max_like_count, paging, sort_by. Fuzzy: compare title exactly. Songs of an album: show_album -> songs[i]['id']. Ignore if it does not fit.
spotify.show_playlist: access_token optional. Songs are under songs[i]['id'] (not song_id/song_ids), each with duration (seconds) and artists[i]['id']. For release_date/genre/play_count use show_song. Ignore if it does not fit.
spotify.show_song_queue: Takes only access_token; NO page_index/page_limit (returns the whole queue). Items: song_id, position, is_current, is_playing, duration. 'Played so far' means positions up to and including the is_current item. Ignore if it does not fit.
spotify.show_song_library: Params: access_token, query, page_index, page_limit (max 20), sort_by; NO artist/genre filter (get those from show_song). Items use song_id; artists[i]['id'] gives artist ids. Loop all pages before removing anything. Ignore if it does not fit.
spotify.show_liked_songs: Items use song_id (not id); artists[i]['id'] gives artist ids. page_limit max 20: loop page_index until an empty page. Ignore if it does not fit.
spotify.download_song: Raises 422 if the song is already downloaded: skip it (check show_downloaded_songs first or wrap in try/except). Ignore if it does not fit.
spotify.previous_song: Success returns a message and song_id; failure raises an exception. Call exactly as many times as needed and re-check show_current_song rather than looping blindly. Same for next_song. Ignore if it does not fit.
spotify.play_music: Pass at most one of song_id / album_id / playlist_id (plus access_token). Afterwards confirm with show_current_song / show_song_queue if the task depends on what is playing. Ignore if it does not fit.
spotify.review_song: Params: song_id, rating, title, text, access_token (no comment/review). One review per user per song (409 if it exists): use update_song_review(review_id=...). Find reviews with show_song_reviews (no access_token; filter user_email). Ignore if it does not fit.
venmo.create_transaction: Money param is amount; text goes in description (there is no note=). Call ONCE per payment: after success (returns transaction_id) never retry. Pass payment_card_id of a non-expired card from show_payment_cards if the balance is short; avoid adding cards or topping up unless asked. Ignore if it does not fit.
venmo.show_transactions: Params: query, user_email (only with that person), min_created_at/max_created_at (YYYY-MM-DD; no start_date), min/max_amount, min/max_like_count, direction, private, paging. Items: sender/receiver, amount, description. For 'this year/yesterday' use phone.get_current_date_and_time (2023), not the system clock. Ignore if it does not fit.
venmo.show_social_feed: Only access_token + paging (max 20; loop page_index); no filters. To keep a group (e.g. roommates), get emails via phone.search_contacts(relationship=...) and match sender/receiver emails; exclude yourself. Filter dates yourself on created_at. Ignore if it does not fit.
venmo.create_payment_request: Params: user_email (not recipient/receiver_email), amount, description, private, access_token. Create each request once; do not retry after success. Ignore if it does not fit.
phone.search_text_messages: Params: query, phone_number (messages with one contact), only_latest_per_contact, paging (max 20), sort_by. Text is in 'message'. Read the relevant thread first: amounts/names asked for are often inside it. Ignore if it does not fit.
file_system.show_directory: Params: directory_path (not path), substring, entry_type ('all'/'files'/'directories'), recursive. Returns path strings; directory entries end with '/' so rstrip('/') before comparing. '~/' allowed. Dates need show_file (created_at). Same naming for file_exists(file_path), directory_exists(directory_path). Ignore if it does not fit.
file_system.move_file: Params: source_file_path, destination_file_path (full new path incl. file name), overwrite, retain_dates. Moving into a directory needs the directory's trailing file name too. Use retain_dates=True when the task says to keep dates. Ignore if it does not fit.
file_system.create_file: Params: file_path, content, overwrite (no allow_if_exists; that is create_directory's). Write exactly the requested text. CSV: quote a field only if it contains a comma. Names: change only what the task says. Ignore if it does not fit.
simple_note.update_note: Updates replace fields: to change one line, pass the FULL new content (read it with show_note first, keep other lines unchanged). Checklist lines like '[ ] item' / '[x] item': flip only the marker. Ignore if it does not fit.
spotify.update_song_review: Params: review_id (not song_id), rating, title, text, access_token. Get review_id from show_song_reviews (no access_token; user_email filter) - items have a review id key, check its name. Ignore if it does not fit.
spotify.show_song_reviews: No access_token. Params: song_id, query, user_email, min/max_rating, paging, sort_by. Use user_email=<your email> to find your own review, then update_song_review(review_id=...). Ignore if it does not fit.
file_system.create_directory: Params: directory_path (not path), recursive, allow_if_exists. Use allow_if_exists=True when it may already exist. Ignore if it does not fit.
venmo.create_transaction_comment: Params: transaction_id, comment (not 'text'/'message'), access_token. Comment once per transaction; do not retry after success. Liking is a separate call (like_transaction). Ignore if it does not fit.
venmo.show_payment_cards: Items carry payment_card_id (not 'id') plus card_name, last_four_digits, expiry; pass payment_card_id to create_transaction if a card is needed. Page through results. Ignore if it does not fit.
phone.send_text_message: Params: phone_number, message, access_token (not 'text'/'to'). First read the incoming request and apply the filter it states (e.g. only one director's or one category's items), print the message you will send, then send it once. Ignore if it does not fit.
spotify.show_playlist_library: Items hold playlist_id, title and song_ids (list of ids). Page with page_limit=20 until an empty page. To combine playlists, collect ids into a set so a song in several playlists counts once. Ignore if it does not fit.
spotify.show_album_library: Items hold album_id, title and song_ids (list of ids). Page with page_limit=20 until an empty page. To combine albums, collect ids into a set so each song counts once. 'Liked' is a property of songs: intersect with show_liked_songs ids. Ignore if it does not fit.
spotify.follow_artist: Params: artist_id, access_token. Do not wrap calls in try/except that hides errors; print the response so a failure is visible, and follow each artist once. Ignore if it does not fit.
spotify.show_following_artists: Paged (default 5, max 20): loop page_index until an empty page before concluding who is or is not followed. Items use artist_id. Ignore if it does not fit.
spotify.show_downloaded_songs: Paged (default 5, max 20): loop page_index until an empty page. Items use song_id. Compare against your target set of ids to download only the missing ones. Ignore if it does not fit.
file_system.show_file: Print the file content before parsing it: amounts/totals may appear next to labels (e.g. a line starting 'Total'); take the labelled value, not the first number. Dates (created_at) come from here, not show_directory. Ignore if it does not fit.
file_system.compress_directory: Give an explicit non-empty compressed_file_path ending in .zip; an empty or wrong name can create '.zip' and delete the source directory. Leave delete_directory=False unless the task says to remove it. Ignore if it does not fit.
simple_note.show_note: Content is free-form markdown, often 'Name' lines followed by '- key: value' sub-lines. Print the raw content first, then parse the lines you actually see. Use search_notes(query=...) to find a note; page results. Ignore if it does not fit.
simple_note.search_notes: Params: query, page_index, page_limit (default 5, max 20), tags. Loop pages until empty, then call show_note(note_id=...) for the content; results omit the full body. Ignore if it does not fit.
